# Generator for valid hostname/domain strings and related filenames for GeoIP
# The fuzz stubs primarily pull with FUZZ_PARAM_STR() and FUZZ_PARAM_FILENAME().
# We build a single bytes blob that concatenates several interesting strings
# separated by newlines so the harness can slice/use them as needed.
#
# Content strategy (lines):
# 1. Common simple hostnames
# 2. Fully-qualified domains with various TLDs, public suffix edge cases
# 3. Internationalized domains in punycode and mixed case
# 4. Subdomain depth variations and wildcard-like names
# 5. Numeric hostnames and labels containing hyphens/underscores (still valid labels avoid underscore in DNS but keep for app-level)
# 6. Repeated popular service host patterns
# 7. IPv4/IPv6 textual forms because some APIs accept IP-like strings
# 8. Filenames for GeoIP loaders; provide multiple plausible filenames
# 9. Hostnames sized at boundaries (very short, near 255 total length, and 128 boundary used by stubs)
# 10. A couple of mDNS/localhost-like names
#
# The returned bytes are <= 4096.

PUBLIC_SUFFIX_VARIANTS = [
    "com", "net", "org", "io", "co.uk", "gov", "edu", "de", "jp", "cn", "it", "fr", "es",
    "info", "biz", "xyz", "top", "club", "site", "online", "shop", "tech"
]

LABEL_CHARS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-"

PUNYCODE_SAMPLES = [
    "xn--bcher-kva.example",           # bücher.example
    "xn--fiqs8s.cn",                   # 中国.cn
    "xn--fsqu00a.xn--0zwm56d",         # 例子.测试
    "xn--vermgensberatung-pwb.example",# vermögensberatung.example
]

COMMON_HOSTS = [
    "example", "localhost", "intranet", "router", "host", "example.com",
    "www.example.com", "api.example.com", "cdn.example.net", "m.example.org",
    "sub.example.co.uk", "www.example.co.uk", "mail.example.io"
]

POPULAR_SERVICES = [
    "www.google.com", "mail.google.com", "drive.google.com",
    "www.youtube.com", "i.ytimg.com", "www.facebook.com",
    "api.twitter.com", "cdn.cloudflare.com", "one.one.one.one",
    "8.8.8.8", "1.1.1.1", "2606:4700:4700::1111", "2001:4860:4860::8888"
]

GEOIP_FILENAMES = [
    "GeoLite2-City.mmdb", "GeoLite2-ASN.mmdb", "GeoLite2-Country.mmdb",
    "city.mmdb", "asn.mmdb", "geoip.dat", "MaxMind-DB.mmdb"
]


def _rand_label(rng: random.Random, min_len=1, max_len=20):
    n = rng.randint(min_len, max_len)
    # labels cannot start or end with hyphen per RFC; adjust accordingly
    chars = [rng.choice(LABEL_CHARS) for _ in range(n)]
    if chars[0] == '-':
        chars[0] = rng.choice('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789')
    if chars[-1] == '-':
        chars[-1] = rng.choice('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789')
    return ''.join(chars)


def _rand_domain(rng: random.Random, depth=None):
    if depth is None:
        depth = rng.randint(1, 4)
    labels = [_rand_label(rng, 1, rng.randint(3, 15)) for _ in range(depth)]
    suffix = rng.choice(PUBLIC_SUFFIX_VARIANTS)
    name = '.'.join(labels + [suffix])
    return name


def _boundary_max_domain(rng: random.Random, total_len):
    # Build a domain whose total length is close to total_len (<= total_len)
    # Each label <=63, total <=255 including dots. We try to fit.
    parts = []
    remaining = min(total_len, 255)
    # ensure we leave room for at least one TLD of len>=2
    tld = rng.choice(PUBLIC_SUFFIX_VARIANTS)
    remaining -= len(tld)
    if remaining <= 1:
        return tld
    # account for dot joining
    # Build labels until we nearly fill remaining - number of dots
    while remaining > 1:
        # remaining includes dots; estimate next label length
        max_label = min(63, max(1, remaining - 2))
        l = rng.randint(1, min(20, max_label))
        lab = _rand_label(rng, l, l)
        # dot + label cost (except first label has cost label + 1 for following dot)
        parts.append(lab)
        # Each label adds len(lab) + 1 (the dot) to remaining accounting, except we will replace last dot by TLD
        remaining -= (len(lab) + 1)
        if remaining <= 1:
            break
        # Limit number of labels to avoid overrun
        if len(parts) >= 10:
            break
    domain = '.'.join(parts + [tld])
    if len(domain) > total_len:
        domain = domain[:total_len]
        # avoid trailing dot cut or partial punycode; this is okay for generic fuzz, keep ASCII slice
        if domain.endswith('.'):
            domain = domain[:-1]
    return domain


def _mix_case(rng: random.Random, s: str) -> str:
    return ''.join(c.upper() if rng.random() < 0.5 else c.lower() for c in s)


def _mdns_like(rng: random.Random):
    name = _rand_label(rng, 3, 10)
    service = rng.choice(["_http", "_printer", "_rtsp", "_airplay", "_ssh", "_workstation"]) + "._tcp"
    return f"{name}.{service}.local"


def _ipv6_text(rng: random.Random):
    # produce valid IPv6 textual address using ipaddress
    addr = ipaddress.IPv6Address(rng.getrandbits(128))
    return addr.compressed


def _ipv4_text(rng: random.Random):
    return str(ipaddress.IPv4Address(rng.getrandbits(32)))


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)

    lines = []
    # 1. Common hosts
    lines.extend(COMMON_HOSTS)

    # 2. Random domains (various depths)
    for _ in range(8):
        lines.append(_rand_domain(rng))

    # 3. Punycode and mixed case variants
    for p in PUNYCODE_SAMPLES:
        lines.append(p)
        lines.append(_mix_case(rng, p))

    # 4. Deep subdomains and wildcard-like
    lines.append("a.b.c.d." + rng.choice(PUBLIC_SUFFIX_VARIANTS))
    lines.append("*.example." + rng.choice(PUBLIC_SUFFIX_VARIANTS))

    # 5. Numeric-like labels and hyphen usage
    lines.append("n1-2-3.example.com")
    lines.append("12345.example.net")
    lines.append("api-v2.service." + rng.choice(PUBLIC_SUFFIX_VARIANTS))

    # 6. Popular services
    lines.extend(POPULAR_SERVICES)

    # 7. IP literals (v4/v6)
    for _ in range(3):
        lines.append(_ipv4_text(rng))
        lines.append(_ipv6_text(rng))

    # 8. GeoIP filenames
    # Provide a couple on distinct lines so stubs that call FUZZ_PARAM_FILENAME get plausible values
    rng.shuffle(GEOIP_FILENAMES)
    lines.extend(GEOIP_FILENAMES[:5])

    # 9. Boundary sizes: very short, 128-limit, near 255
    lines.append("a")
    lines.append(_boundary_max_domain(rng, 128))
    lines.append(_boundary_max_domain(rng, 250))

    # 10. mDNS/localhost flavors
    lines.append("localhost.localdomain")
    lines.append(_mdns_like(rng))

    # Ensure uniqueness and shuffle to add randomness per seed
    # Keep order for some deterministic start but then shuffle tail
    fixed = lines[:10]
    rest = lines[10:]
    rng.shuffle(rest)
    lines = fixed + rest

    # Join with newlines; ensure total size <= 4096
    blob = '\n'.join(lines).encode('utf-8')
    if len(blob) > 4096:
        blob = blob[:4096]
        # Avoid ending mid-UTF8; best-effort backtrack to previous newline
        nl = blob.rfind(b'\n')
        if nl != -1 and nl >= 1024:  # keep reasonably sized content
            blob = blob[:nl]
    return blob
